    AND ship_to.ship_to_id = oe_hdr.address_id  INNER JOIN terms ON terms.terms_id = oe_hdr.terms  INNER JOIN invoice_batch ON invoice_batch.invoice_batch_uid = oe_pick_ticket.invoice_batch_uid  LEFT JOIN contacts ON contacts.id = oe_hdr.contact_id  LEFT JOIN freight_code ON freight_code.freight_code_uid = oe_pick_ticket.freight_code_uid  LEFT JOIN shipping_route ON (shipping_route.shipping_route_uid = oe_hdr.shipping_route_uid AND oe_pick_ticket.shipping_route_uid IS NULL)
    OR (shipping_route.shipping_route_uid = oe_pick_ticket.shipping_route_uid)  LEFT JOIN currency_line ON currency_line.currency_line_uid = oe_hdr.currency_line_uid  LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no
    FROM
    oe_pick_ticket
    INNER JOIN oe_pick_ticket_detail ON oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket_detail.pick_ticket_no
    INNER JOIN oe_line ON oe_pick_ticket.order_no = oe_line.order_no
    AND oe_pick_ticket_detail.oe_line_no = oe_line.line_no
    INNER JOIN oe_line_service ON oe_line_service.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid
    AND oe_line_service.row_status_flag IN (1732, 1733)
    WHERE  oe_pick_ticket.oe_pick_ticket_type_cd = 1921) AS drv_Service ON drv_Service.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no  LEFT JOIN group_pick_ticket_detail ON group_pick_ticket_detail.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no  LEFT JOIN group_pick_ticket_hdr ON group_pick_ticket_hdr.group_pick_ticket_hdr_uid = group_pick_ticket_detail.group_pick_ticket_hdr_uid
    AND group_pick_ticket_hdr.transaction_type_cd = 1941  LEFT JOIN oe_hdr_progress_billing ON oe_hdr_progress_billing.order_no = oe_hdr.order_no  LEFT JOIN (SELECT oe_pick_ticket_detail.pick_ticket_no
    ,oe_line.item_bill_to_id
    ,customer.ar_account_no
    ,customer.revenue_account_no
    ,customer.cos_account_no
    ,customer.freight_account_no
    ,customer.brokerage_account_no
    ,customer.taxable_flag
    ,customer.invoice_print_qty
    FROM
    oe_pick_ticket_detail
    INNER JOIN oe_pick_ticket ON oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket_detail.pick_ticket_no
    INNER JOIN oe_line ON (oe_line.line_no = oe_pick_ticket_detail.oe_line_no)
    AND (oe_line.order_no = oe_pick_ticket.order_no)
    INNER JOIN oe_hdr ON (oe_line.order_no = oe_hdr.order_no)
    INNER JOIN customer ON (customer.customer_id = oe_line.item_bill_to_id)
    AND (customer.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id)
    WHERE  oe_pick_ticket_detail.line_number = 1) drv_oe_pick_ticket_detail ON drv_oe_pick_ticket_detail.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no  LEFT JOIN location ON location.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id
    AND location.location_id = oe_hdr.location_id  LEFT JOIN company_strategic_pricing ON company_strategic_pricing.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id  LEFT JOIN address ON address.id = oe_hdr.carrier_id  LEFT JOIN customer_strategic_pricing ON customer_strategic_pricing.customer_id = oe_hdr.customer_id
    AND customer_strategic_pricing.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id  LEFT JOIN oe_pick_ticket_ups ON oe_pick_ticket_ups.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no  LEFT JOIN shipping_route AS ups_shipping_route ON ups_shipping_route.shipping_route_uid = oe_pick_ticket_ups.shipping_route_uid  LEFT JOIN contacts AS driver ON driver.id = oe_pick_ticket_ups.driver_id  LEFT JOIN contacts AS generic_driver ON generic_driver.id = oe_pick_ticket.driver_id  LEFT JOIN oe_pick_ticket_detail
    ON (oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket_detail.pick_ticket_no)
    AND oe_pick_ticket_detail.line_number = 1  LEFT JOIN customer_terms AS drv_customer_terms
    ON drv_customer_terms.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id
    AND drv_customer_terms.customer_id = oe_hdr.customer_id
    AND drv_customer_terms.type_no = 212
    AND drv_customer_terms.row_status_flag = 704
    AND drv_customer_terms.type_uid = oe_pick_ticket_detail.inv_mast_uid  LEFT JOIN terms AS drv_customer_terms_item
    ON (drv_customer_terms_item.terms_id = drv_customer_terms.terms_id)  LEFT JOIN oe_line
    ON (oe_line.order_no = oe_hdr.order_no)
    AND (oe_line.line_no = oe_pick_ticket_detail.oe_line_no)  LEFT JOIN product_group
    ON (product_group.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id)
    AND (product_group.product_group_id = oe_line.product_group_id)  LEFT JOIN customer_terms AS drv_customer_terms_with_pg
    ON (drv_customer_terms_with_pg.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id)
    AND (drv_customer_terms_with_pg.customer_id = oe_hdr.customer_id)
    AND (drv_customer_terms_with_pg.type_no = 218)
    AND (drv_customer_terms_with_pg.row_status_flag = 704)
    AND (drv_customer_terms_with_pg.type_uid = product_group.product_group_uid)
    LEFT JOIN terms AS drv_customer_terms_pg
    ON (drv_customer_terms_pg.terms_id = drv_customer_terms_with_pg.terms_id)
    CROSS JOIN system_setting  LEFT JOIN address customer_address ON customer_address.id = COALESCE(drv_oe_pick_ticket_detail.item_bill_to_id, oe_hdr.customer_id)  LEFT JOIN location_packing_options ON location_packing_options.location_id = oe_pick_ticket.location_id  /*MAIN WHERE CLAUSE*/  WHERE  oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no = :pick_ticket_no
    AND oe_pick_ticket.invoice_no IS NULL
    AND oe_pick_ticket.delete_flag <> 'Y'
    AND oe_pick_ticket.auxiliary = 'N'
    AND oe_pick_ticket.direct_shipment <> 'Y'
    AND system_setting.configuration_id = 0
    AND system_setting.name = 'confirm_shipment'
    AND oe_hdr.rma_flag = 'N'
    AND ((oe_pick_ticket.oe_pick_ticket_type_cd = 1921 AND drv_service.pick_ticket_no IS NOT NULL)
    OR (oe_pick_ticket.oe_pick_ticket_type_cd IS NULL OR oe_pick_ticket.oe_pick_ticket_type_cd <> 1921))  /*MAIN ORDER BY CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN HAVING CLAUSE*/  /*MAIN GROUP BY CLAUSE*/

SELECT
    customer_notepad.note_id ,
    customer_notepad.topic ,
    customer_notepad.note ,
    customer_notepad.mandatory ,
    notepad_class.notepad_class_desc,
    customer_notepad.notepad_class,
    customer_notepad.activation_date,
    customer_notepad.expiration_date,
    customer_notepad.entry_date,
    customer_notepad.delete_flag,
    customer_notepad.date_created,
    customer_notepad.date_last_modified,
    customer_notepad.last_maintained_by,
    customer_notepad.created_by  FROM
    customer_notepad
    INNER JOIN note_area ON note_area.note_id = customer_notepad.note_id
    LEFT JOIN notepad_class ON notepad_class.notepad_class_id = customer_notepad.notepad_class
    WHERE  ( ( customer_notepad.company_id = :company_id )
    and
    ( customer_notepad.customer_id = :customer_id )
    and
    ( note_area.area = :area )
    and
    ( customer_notepad.activation_date <= :today )
    and
    ( customer_notepad.expiration_date >= :today )
    and
    ( customer_notepad.delete_flag = 'N' ) )
    ORDER BY
    customer_notepad.note_id
    ASC

    INNER JOIN oe_line_service ON oe_line_service.oe_line_uid = oe_line.oe_line_uid
    AND oe_line_service.row_status_flag IN (1732, 1733)
    WHERE  oe_pick_ticket.oe_pick_ticket_type_cd = 1921) AS drv_Service ON drv_Service.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no  LEFT JOIN group_pick_ticket_detail ON group_pick_ticket_detail.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no  LEFT JOIN group_pick_ticket_hdr ON group_pick_ticket_hdr.group_pick_ticket_hdr_uid = group_pick_ticket_detail.group_pick_ticket_hdr_uid
    AND group_pick_ticket_hdr.transaction_type_cd = 1941  LEFT JOIN oe_hdr_progress_billing ON oe_hdr_progress_billing.order_no = oe_hdr.order_no  LEFT JOIN (SELECT oe_pick_ticket_detail.pick_ticket_no

    INNER JOIN oe_hdr ON (oe_line.order_no = oe_hdr.order_no)

    AND (customer.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id)
    WHERE  oe_pick_ticket_detail.line_number = 1) drv_oe_pick_ticket_detail ON drv_oe_pick_ticket_detail.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no  LEFT JOIN location ON location.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id

    AND customer_strategic_pricing.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id  LEFT JOIN oe_pick_ticket_ups ON oe_pick_ticket_ups.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no  LEFT JOIN shipping_route AS ups_shipping_route ON ups_shipping_route.shipping_route_uid = oe_pick_ticket_ups.shipping_route_uid  LEFT JOIN contacts AS driver ON driver.id = oe_pick_ticket_ups.driver_id  LEFT JOIN contacts AS generic_driver ON generic_driver.id = oe_pick_ticket.driver_id  LEFT JOIN oe_pick_ticket_detail
    ON (oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no = oe_pick_ticket_detail.pick_ticket_no)
    AND oe_pick_ticket_detail.line_number = 1  LEFT JOIN customer_terms AS drv_customer_terms
    ON drv_customer_terms.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id
    AND drv_customer_terms.customer_id = oe_hdr.customer_id
    AND drv_customer_terms.type_no = 212
    AND drv_customer_terms.row_status_flag = 704
    AND drv_customer_terms.type_uid = oe_pick_ticket_detail.inv_mast_uid  LEFT JOIN terms AS drv_customer_terms_item
    ON (drv_customer_terms_item.terms_id = drv_customer_terms.terms_id)  LEFT JOIN oe_line
    ON (oe_line.order_no = oe_hdr.order_no)
    AND (oe_line.line_no = oe_pick_ticket_detail.oe_line_no)  LEFT JOIN product_group
    ON (product_group.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id)
    AND (product_group.product_group_id = oe_line.product_group_id)  LEFT JOIN customer_terms AS drv_customer_terms_with_pg
    ON (drv_customer_terms_with_pg.company_id = oe_hdr.company_id)
    AND (drv_customer_terms_with_pg.customer_id = oe_hdr.customer_id)
    AND (drv_customer_terms_with_pg.type_no = 218)
    AND (drv_customer_terms_with_pg.row_status_flag = 704)
    AND (drv_customer_terms_with_pg.type_uid = product_group.product_group_uid)
    LEFT JOIN terms AS drv_customer_terms_pg
    ON (drv_customer_terms_pg.terms_id = drv_customer_terms_with_pg.terms_id)
    CROSS JOIN system_setting  LEFT JOIN address customer_address ON customer_address.id = COALESCE(drv_oe_pick_ticket_detail.item_bill_to_id, oe_hdr.customer_id)  LEFT JOIN location_packing_options ON location_packing_options.location_id = oe_pick_ticket.location_id  /*MAIN WHERE CLAUSE*/  WHERE  oe_pick_ticket.pick_ticket_no = :pick_ticket_no
    AND oe_pick_ticket.invoice_no IS NULL
    AND oe_pick_ticket.delete_flag <> 'Y'
